# Hyderabad House Omaha

> Authentic Hyderabadi and South Indian restaurant in West Omaha, Nebraska. Slow-cooked dum biryani, tandoori kebabs, Andhra curries, vegetarian specials, and halal meats. Open daily 11 AM to 9 PM. Dine-in, takeout, private party hall, and catering.

Location: 2537 S 174th Plz, Omaha, NE 68130
Phone: +1 (402) 505-9209
Email: hhbiryani.oma@gmail.com
Hours: Monday–Sunday, 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM

- [Contact Us](https://www.hhoma.com/contact): Address, phone, map, hours, and contact form.

- [FAQ](https://www.hhoma.com/faq): Answers to common questions about hours, catering, and reservations.
- [Testimonials](https://www.hhoma.com/testimonials): Reviews from customers in Omaha, West Omaha, Elkhorn, Papillion, and Bellevue.

## Campaigns

- [October Biryani Utsav](https://www.hhoma.com/biryani-utsav): Month-long campaign (Oct 1–31) offering a different half-tray biryani every Monday through Thursday, pickup only, $50 per tray.

## Ordering and reservations

- Online ordering: https://hyderabadhouse.hungerrush.com/Order/OrderType
- Pickup and delivery via HungerRush, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub.
- Private party hall seats up to 60 guests. Email or call for bookings.
- Catering: menus tailored to group size and dietary needs. Contact us for a quote.

## Policies

- All meat is halal.
- Both vegetarian and vegan options available across every section.
- Walk-ins welcome, no reservations needed for regular dining.
- Free on-site parking.
- Cash and card accepted.

## Cuisine areas of expertise

- Hyderabadi dum biryani (chicken, goat, vegetable, paneer)
- Thalapakatti biryani (Tamil Nadu style)
- Vijayawada and Pachimirchi biryani (coastal Andhra style)
- Beach-style pulav (coastal South Indian)
- Andhra curries (Gongura, Chettinad)
- North Indian tandoori and curries
- Indo-Chinese starters
- Halal meat preparation
- Indian vegetarian and vegan cooking

## Service areas

Omaha, West Omaha, Elkhorn, Papillion, Bellevue, Millard, La Vista, Council Bluffs.
